reason: This PR changes a fundamental NDV/cardinality estimation formula and threads that behavior through many core planner paths: task selection, scan/index-merge planning, merge join, TiFlash predicate pushdown, and stats propagation. It also adds session/sysvar surface area to control or expose the behavior. That is central optimizer semantics with broad blast radius for plan choice, regression risk, and cluster-wide performance/correctness surprises, so it warrants a focused deep review for high-severity planner/statistics issues.
